source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: The hole order is a guess. The 18 greens are the ones already on the map, but no tee boxes can be seen in the photo, so each tee was placed by hand in open ground at about the card's length, and holes were numbered by matching lengths and pars, not from a scorecard map.
unsure.1: Sharp hook by the green removed; one gentle mid-fairway point kept so the line stays in the corridor south of the tree row. Traced length (~265 yd) is under the card's 335: tee placed by hand, no tee pads visible.
unsure.13: Not changed: the check says a strong dogleg left around water, but the photo shows no water anywhere near this tee-to-green corridor (the ponds lie south, among holes 15, 16 and 18), so the hole order (already a guess) is probably off; fixing it means renumbering the back nine.
